name: FaithBench
description: FaithBench is a diverse hallucination benchmark for summarization by modern large language models, containing challenging hallucinations generated by 10 LLMs from 8 families with expert human annotations. It evaluates hallucination detection models and highlights the difficulty of detecting hallucinations in summaries produced by state-of-the-art LLMs.
reputation: A recent hallucination benchmark for summarization that is gaining attention in the LLM evaluation community, but it is still relatively new.
notes: Includes hallucinations where state-of-the-art detection models disagree; GPT-4o and GPT-3.5-Turbo produce least hallucinations.
